questions.question_text: A line passes through (0, 5) and (2, 11). Determine its linear polynomial function p(x) = ax + b.

Distinguish between linear growth and linear decay with one mathematical example each.

questions.question_text: Two lines y = 5x + 2 and y = 5x - 7 are parallel because they have:
The zero of linear polynomial p(x) = 2x + 6 is:
Find equation of line parallel to y = 4x - 3 passing through point (1, 8).
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Parallel line has same slope a = 4. Equation y = 4x + b. Substitute (1,8): 8 = 4(1) + b => b = 4. Equation is y = 4x + 4.

questions.question_text: Verify whether x = 4 is a zero of polynomial p(x) = 3x - 12.
Temperature conversion from Celsius C to Fahrenheit F is given by F = (9/5)C + 32. (i) Find F when C = 25°C. (ii) Find C when F = 95°F.
Determine slope and intercepts for lines L1: 2x - 3y = 6 and L2: 4x - 6y = 12. Are these lines intersecting, parallel, or coincident?
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
L1: y = (2/3)x - 2 (Slope 2/3, y-intercept -2).
L2: y = (4/6)x - 2 => y = (2/3)x - 2 (Slope 2/3, y-intercept -2).
Since slopes and y-intercepts are identical, lines L1 and L2 are COINCIDENT (infinite intersections).

A spring length L (in cm) under weight W (in kg) is modeled by L(W) = 1.5W + 10. (i) What is natural unweighted length? (ii) Find length with 6 kg weight.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(i) Natural length (W=0) is y-intercept = 10 cm.
(ii) L(6) = 1.5(6) + 10 = 9 + 10 = 19 cm.

Car A travels according to distance D_A = 60t km. Car B starts 20 km ahead and travels according to D_B = 50t + 20 km.
(i) At what time t do both cars meet? (2 Marks)
(ii) What distance has Car A traveled when it catches Car B? (2 Marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(i) Set D_A = D_B => 60t = 50t + 20 => 10t = 20 => t = 2 hours.
(ii) Distance D_A = 60(2) = 120 km.

questions.question_text: If polynomial p(x) = c (where c != 0) is a constant polynomial, its degree is:
The graph of vertical line x = -3 has slope:
Find value of k if line 2x + ky = 9 passes through point (3, -1).
Express 2x = 5y in standard form ax + by + c = 0 and identify values of a, b, c.
Determine whether points (1, 3), (2, 5), and (4, 9) lie on the same straight line.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Slope m1 between (1,3) and (2,5) = (5-3)/(2-1) = 2.
Slope m2 between (2,5) and (4,9) = (9-5)/(4-2) = 4/2 = 2.
Since slopes are equal, points lie on line y = 2x + 1.

questions.question_text: A candle 30 cm long burns at a uniform rate of 2 cm per hour. (i) Formulate remaining height H(t) after t hours. (ii) Calculate height after 7.5 hours. (iii) Find total burn time.

A solar panel generates cumulative energy E(t) = 4t + 10 kWh where t is operating hours.
(i) What is initial energy store at t=0? (2 Marks)
(ii) How many hours are needed to accumulate 50 kWh? (2 Marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(i) Initial store = E(0) = 10 kWh.
(ii) 50 = 4t + 10 => 4t = 40 => t = 10 hours.
